verses.1: And as he was walking away from the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, look! There are stones and buildings everywhere.”
verses.2: And Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? No stone should be left unbroken upon another stone.”
verses.3: And when he was seated on the hill of the olives, facing the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew took turns to teach him.
verses.4: When will this happen to us? And what will be the sign when all of this finally takes place?
verses.5: But Jesus began to speak to them: “See, no one will deceive you.”
verses.6: Many will come to me and say, “I am He.” And many will be deceived.
verses.7: When you hear about wars and witness their effects, do not be alarmed. It must still come to an end, sooner or later.
verses.8: For nations will rise against one another, and kingdoms will rise against kingdoms. There will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines. This is the beginning of all these disasters.
verses.9: But you yourselves must see this: they will bring you before councils and assemblies, so that you may be subjected to punishment. You will stand before rulers and kings as witnesses against them.
verses.10: And first, the gospel must be proclaimed to all nations.
verses.11: And when they bring you before them to be judged, do not worry about what you will say. But if it is given to you to speak in that day, then you should not be the ones who speak; rather, it’s the Holy Spirit who will speak on your behalf.
verses.12: And brothers will deliver each other to death. Fathers will kill their sons, and sons will kill their fathers.
verses.13: And you will be hated by everyone because of my name. But those who remain until the end will be saved.
verses.14: When you see that the desert has been created in places where it doesn’t belong, then those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.15: He who is inside the house does not go out or enter anything from his own home.
verses.16: And do not return to the fields; do not go back to those barren lands.
verses.17: And you will also hear those sounds during the days when you are feeding your babies.
verses.18: Pray also that winter will not come.
verses.19: For those days will be filled with sorrow, since such things have never happened since the beginning of creation, as God created it, and they will not happen ever again.
verses.20: And if the Lord did not enforce these rules, then none of the people would be saved. But because of those who were chosen by Him, He enforced these rules.
verses.21: And then, if anyone says to you, “Look, there’s the Christ! Look over there! But don’t believe it.”
verses.22: For they will be filled with false teachers and deceivers. They will also give signs and wonders, in order to deceive those who are chosen by God.
verses.23: And you see yourselves; I have promised you everything.
verses.24: But on those days, amidst all that sorrow, the sun will be darkened. And the moon will not shed its light at all.
verses.25: And the stars will fall from the sky, and the forces that lie in the heavens will be overwhelmed.
verses.26: And at that time, one will see the son of man coming in the clouds, with great power and glory.
verses.27: And at that time, he would appoint messengers and select those who were chosen from among the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
verses.28: From the shrub, you can tell that it’s a metaphorical representation. When its branches become soft and its leaves start to fall off, you know that it’s a symbol of decay.
verses.29: And you also, when you see these things happening, remember that it’s very close to the time when those doors will be opened.
verses.30: Indeed, I tell you that this generation will not continue until all these things happen.
verses.31: The sky and the earth will be removed from their places, but my words will not be removed from their places.
verses.32: And no one knew about that day or hour. Not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son himself, except for the Father.
verses.33: Look, you’re asleep. You don’t know when the time will come.
verses.34: As a man who has taken over his household, and given his servants their tasks to carry out, he assigned each servant their own work. He also ordered the guard to act quickly.
verses.35: So, hurry up! You don’t know when the master of the household will arrive. Whether it’s through a knock at the door, a signal, or some other means.
verses.36: We will not come to you suddenly, just to surprise you.
verses.37: But what I say to you all, I say quickly: Hurry up.
